benchmark_info.name: Smart Home LLM-based Multi-Agent Benchmark: extension (DRAFT)
benchmark_info.description: 40 additional test cases, 8 per dimension: dependency structure, ambiguity, scale, concurrency, failure recovery. Same format as benchmark_data.json, plus 'dimension', 'annotation' (for C(task)), and for some dimensions 'expected_concurrency' or 'injected_failure' / 'expected_recovery'. See EXTENSION.md.

test_cases.user_input: Check what's in the fridge, find a dinner recipe I can make with it, show the recipe on the TV, and set a timer for the cooking time in the recipe

required_intents.intent: Find dinner recipe from available ingredients
Set timer for the recipe's cooking time

success_conditions: Search obtains ingredients from fridge
Display obtains recipe from search
Clock obtains cooking time from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: A recipe based on the fridge contents is shown on the TV and a timer is set to its cooking time

test_cases.user_input: When is my dentist appointment tomorrow? Set an alarm one hour before it

required_intents.intent: Set alarm one hour before the appointment

success_conditions: Clock obtains appointment time from calendar

test_cases.expected_final_output: The appointment time is reported and an alarm is set one hour before it

test_cases.user_input: Find out when the sun sets today and dim the living room lights at that time

required_intents.intent: Dim living room lights at sunset

success_conditions: Clock obtains sunset time from search
Light is triggered by clock at sunset

test_cases.expected_final_output: The living room lights are scheduled to dim at today's sunset time

test_cases.user_input: Check tomorrow's weather. If it will be cold, set the bedroom to 22 degrees for tonight, otherwise to 19 degrees, and add the forecast to my calendar

required_intents.intent: Set bedroom temperature depending on forecast

test_cases.note: The thermostat setting is conditional on the forecast

success_conditions: Thermostat obtains forecast from search
Calendar obtains forecast from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: The bedroom temperature matches the forecast (22 or 19 degrees) and the forecast is in the calendar

test_cases.user_input: See what in the fridge is about to expire, find a recipe that uses it, and add 'cook dinner' with the recipe name to my calendar at 7 pm

required_intents.intent: Find recipe using the expiring food
Add 'cook dinner' event with recipe name at 7 pm

success_conditions: Search obtains expiring food from fridge
Calendar obtains recipe name from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: A recipe using the expiring food is found and a 'cook dinner' event with its name is added at 7 pm

test_cases.user_input: Check my calendar for this evening and the weather forecast. If I'm at home and it's raining, put a movie on the TV and warm up the living room
test_cases.note: Both actions are conditional on both lookups

success_conditions: Display and thermostat actions depend on the calendar and the weather result

test_cases.expected_final_output: If the user is at home and it rains, a movie plays and the living room is warmer; otherwise nothing is changed

test_cases.user_input: Find a 30-minute workout video and play it on the TV. When it ends, set the lights back to normal and play relaxing music

required_intents.intent: Play relaxing music after the workout

success_conditions: Display obtains video from search
Audio obtains relaxing music from search
Light and audio start after the video ends

test_cases.expected_final_output: The workout video plays; afterwards the lights are reset and relaxing music plays

test_cases.user_input: Check if I have eggs and flour. If I do, find a pancake recipe and show it on the kitchen screen. If not, add 'buy eggs and flour' to tomorrow's schedule

required_intents.intent: Show recipe on kitchen screen if available
Add shopping reminder for tomorrow if missing

test_cases.note: Exactly one branch should run, depending on the fridge result

success_conditions: Search runs only if the fridge has eggs and flour
Display obtains recipe from search
Calendar runs only if something is missing

test_cases.expected_final_output: Either a pancake recipe is shown on the kitchen screen or a shopping reminder is added, depending on the fridge

test_cases.user_input: It's too bright in here
test_cases.note: 'In here' does not name a room
test_cases.expected_final_output: Brightness is reduced where the user is

test_cases.user_input: I can't sleep
test_cases.expected_final_output: The environment is adjusted for sleep

test_cases.user_input: Get the house ready for the morning

acceptable_intents.intent: Warm up the house in the morning

test_cases.expected_final_output: Morning preparations are scheduled

test_cases.user_input: Something for the kids, please
test_cases.expected_final_output: Kid-appropriate entertainment or activities are offered

test_cases.user_input: Turn it down
test_cases.note: Without context the system should choose the device that is currently active, or ask
test_cases.expected_final_output: The currently active device is turned down, or the system asks which one

test_cases.user_input: Remind me about the thing tomorrow

acceptable_intents.intent: Add a reminder for the event

test_cases.note: 'The thing' must be resolved from the calendar or by asking

success_conditions: The reminder obtains the event from the calendar lookup

test_cases.expected_final_output: The event is identified from the calendar (or the user is asked) and a reminder is set

test_cases.user_input: I'm working from home today
test_cases.expected_final_output: A working environment is prepared

test_cases.user_input: Set the mood for a date night

acceptable_intents.intent: Find a dinner recipe or restaurant

test_cases.expected_final_output: A romantic atmosphere is set

test_cases.user_input: Good morning routine: turn on the bedroom and kitchen lights, set the kitchen to 21 degrees, show today's schedule and the weather on the TV, play the news podcast, and start a 5-minute timer for the eggs

required_intents.intent: Show schedule and weather on TV

success_conditions: Display obtains schedule from calendar and weather from search
Audio obtains the podcast from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: All eight morning actions are done

test_cases.user_input: We're leaving for the weekend: turn off all the lights, set every room to 16 degrees, add 'back home' on Sunday at 6 pm to my calendar, check what in the fridge will expire before Sunday, and set an alarm for Friday at 7 am
test_cases.expected_final_output: The home is set to away mode, the calendar entry and alarm exist, and expiring food is listed

test_cases.user_input: Party in an hour: set the living room lights to party colors, make the kitchen lights bright, play an upbeat playlist, show a fireplace video on the TV, set the living room to 20 degrees, find a quick cocktail recipe, and remind me in 45 minutes to take the pizza out

required_intents.intent: Set living room lights to party colors
Remind in 45 minutes to take the pizza out

success_conditions: Audio obtains playlist from search
Display obtains fireplace video from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: All seven party preparations are done

test_cases.user_input: Prepare the bedroom, the guest room and the kids' room for guests: lights at 50 percent and temperature at 21 degrees in each, and add their arrival on Friday at 6 pm to my calendar

required_intents.intent: Add guests' arrival on Friday 6 pm

test_cases.expected_final_output: Three rooms are prepared and the arrival is in the calendar

test_cases.user_input: Plan my dinners for the week: check the fridge, find five dinner recipes using what I have, list the missing ingredients, add a shopping trip on Saturday at 10 am to my calendar, and show the meal plan on the TV

required_intents.intent: Find five dinner recipes using available food
Add shopping trip on Saturday 10 am

success_conditions: Search obtains ingredients from fridge
Fridge obtains recipe ingredients from search
Calendar obtains shopping list
Display obtains meal plan from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: A week of dinners is planned, missing ingredients are listed, the shopping trip is scheduled and the plan is shown

test_cases.user_input: Movie night for four: dim the living room lights, set the living room to 22 degrees, find a family comedy and put it on the TV, find a popcorn recipe, check if we have corn kernels, and set a 2-hour timer to remind the kids to go to bed

success_conditions: Display obtains the comedy from search
Fridge obtains popcorn ingredients from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: Movie night is set up, ingredients are checked and the bedtime timer runs

test_cases.user_input: Study session this afternoon: brighten the study, set the study to 20 degrees, play focus music, set a 50-minute timer, block the afternoon in my calendar, and show my to-do list for today on the screen

required_intents.intent: Show today's to-do list on screen

success_conditions: Audio obtains focus music from search
Display obtains the to-do list from calendar

test_cases.expected_final_output: The study is prepared and the afternoon is blocked

test_cases.user_input: Holiday dinner: set the living room, dining room and kitchen lights to warm white, play holiday music in the living room, show the roast turkey recipe on the kitchen screen, set a 3-hour timer for the oven, and add 'dinner with family' at 6 pm to my calendar

required_intents.intent: Living room lights to warm white
Dining room lights to warm white
Play holiday music in the living room

success_conditions: Audio obtains holiday music from search
Display obtains recipe from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: All eight holiday preparations are done

test_cases.user_input: Turn the bedroom lights off and set them to reading mode

required_intents.intent: Set bedroom lights to reading mode

test_cases.note: Contradictory settings for the same lights
test_cases.expected_final_output: The system notices the contradiction and asks, or applies one setting after the other; never both at once

test_cases.user_input: Set the living room to 18 degrees for the plants and to 23 degrees because I'm cold
test_cases.note: Contradictory settings for the same thermostat
test_cases.expected_final_output: The system notices the contradiction and asks which temperature to use

test_cases.user_input: Show the football match on the TV and put my calendar on the TV too

required_intents.intent: Show the football match on TV

test_cases.note: Two contents for the same TV

success_conditions: Display obtains the schedule from calendar

test_cases.expected_final_output: Both contents are shown one after the other (or side by side if supported), not overwriting each other

test_cases.user_input: Dim the bedroom lights, brighten the kitchen lights, warm up the bathroom, and play music in the living room

required_intents.intent: Play music in the living room

test_cases.note: All four tasks are independent and can run in parallel
test_cases.expected_final_output: All four independent actions are done

test_cases.user_input: Play my workout playlist and also play the meditation sounds
test_cases.note: Two audio contents for the same speaker
test_cases.expected_final_output: The system notices that both need the same speaker and asks, or plays one after the other

test_cases.user_input: Set a 10-minute timer for the pasta, a 25-minute timer for the sauce, and an alarm for 6 am tomorrow
test_cases.note: Several timers on one clock do not conflict
test_cases.expected_final_output: Two timers and an alarm are set

test_cases.user_input: Show my schedule on the TV, and meanwhile check the weather and what's in the fridge
test_cases.note: Calendar, weather and fridge can run in parallel; the display waits for the calendar

success_conditions: Display obtains the schedule from calendar

test_cases.expected_final_output: The schedule is shown, and the weather and fridge contents are reported

test_cases.user_input: Turn on all the lights, set every room to 21 degrees, and start the morning playlist, all at once

success_conditions: Audio obtains the playlist from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: All three actions are done

test_cases.user_input: Dim the bedroom lights, set the bedroom to 20 degrees, and play sleep sounds
test_cases.expected_final_output: Lights and sleep sounds are done; the thermostat failure is reported

test_cases.user_input: Find a lasagna recipe, show it on the TV, and set a 1-hour timer

success_conditions: Display obtains recipe from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: The recipe is found and the timer set; the TV failure is reported and the recipe is offered another way

test_cases.user_input: Check what's in the fridge and find a recipe with those ingredients

success_conditions: Search obtains ingredients from fridge

test_cases.expected_final_output: The fridge failure is reported; no recipe is presented as if the ingredients were known

test_cases.user_input: Look up my first meeting tomorrow and set an alarm one hour before it

required_intents.intent: Set alarm one hour before the meeting

success_conditions: Clock obtains meeting time from calendar

test_cases.expected_final_output: The calendar failure is reported; no alarm is set at a guessed time

test_cases.user_input: Play jazz in the living room and turn on the living room lights

required_intents.intent: Play jazz in the living room

test_cases.note: The audio agent reports success, but the observed state shows no music playing
test_cases.expected_final_output: The lights are on; the system notices that no music is playing and reports it

test_cases.user_input: Set the living room to 22 degrees, then put a movie on the TV, then dim the lights
test_cases.note: 'Then' orders the steps, but the movie and the lights do not depend on the temperature

success_conditions: Display obtains movie from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: Movie and lights are done; the thermostat failure is reported without undoing or repeating the rest

test_cases.user_input: Check the weather, and if it's going to rain, add 'take an umbrella' to tomorrow morning in my calendar

required_intents.intent: Add umbrella reminder if it rains

success_conditions: Calendar obtains the forecast from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: The weather failure is reported; no reminder is added or skipped silently

test_cases.user_input: Start a 25-minute focus timer, block the next hour in my calendar, and play focus music

required_intents.intent: Block the next hour in calendar

test_cases.note: After planning, someone else adds a meeting in the next hour: the plan for the calendar is outdated

success_conditions: Audio obtains focus music from search

test_cases.expected_final_output: Timer and music are done; the clash with the new meeting is detected and reported instead of overwriting it
